_about: Decision rules for automatic confirmation (knowledge/print-wiki-merge.md, Measurement), read by p13_review.py. Two rules: rule classes of the fields, measured on the complete objects of the frozen review sample, and routes of the concordance, measured on the claim sheet of the blind samples. A class is a rule or route bound to one volume (name@volume) and may confirm only there. Only the classes listed as admissible may confirm; p13_review.py --fix-rule fixes them before any decision or answer, as the classes with at least minExpectedJudged values (claims) expected in the sample, and records the code they were fixed on; when that code changes, the rule is invalidated until the classes are fixed again. A class confirms when its weighted precision exceeds the threshold, tested on the bootstrap that resamples objects (entries) within strata, one-sided at level alpha with Holm's correction over the admissible classes of its rule; this is the lower bound of the object-resampled interval at the corrected level. While a threshold is null nothing confirms.

fields.thresholdReason: operator decision: no automatic confirmation in this phase; every confirmation is a person's

routes.thresholdReason: operator decision: no automatic confirmation in this phase; every confirmation is a person's
